item.title: 'Bottling it' - Garcia no-show for first Benn face-off
item.description: Conor Benn said Ryan Garcia "bottled" their first face-off after the American failed to turn up to their meeting on Tuesday in Las Vegas.

item.description: Thomas Carty's team claim "two illegal blows" and "loose ropes" caused the Irishman to topple out of the ring in a bizarre first-round no-contest against David Allen.

item.description: As Katie Taylor hangs up her gloves, BBC Sport picks the best pictures of her career.

item.title: 'One of the best' - boxing world reacts to Taylor's farewell win
item.description: Some of the biggest names in women's boxing pay tribute to Katie Taylor after the Irish great ended her career with victory over Flora Pili at Croke Park.

item.title: We want Fury v Joshua at Wembley - London mayor
item.description: London Mayor Sadiq Khan says he is "really keen" to host the proposed Tyson Fury-Anthony Joshua fight at Wembley Stadium and has urged promoters to get in touch.

item.title: AJ v Fury - highly anticipated or a forgotten fight?
item.description: British boxer Pat Brown and journalists Nick Peet and Steph Kamale discuss the prospect of an Anthony Joshua v Tyson Fury fight, and whether it would still attract a worldwide audience, or is it a fight that few actually want?

item.title: Five moments that shaped Taylor's legendary career
item.description: From writing a letter to her idol as a 10-year-old to messaging a promoter on social media, here are five sliding doors moments that helped shape Katie Taylor’s career.

item.title: Ali 'The Greatest' but Maguire the latest to win in Croke Park

item.title: From influencers to queens of women's boxing - five years of MVP
item.description: On Saturday, Most Valuable Promotions celebrates its fifth anniversary. One of the feistiest upstarts in modern boxing has given a new platform to the world's best female fighters.
